svg.title: Spawn regions: Teldrassil's The Balance of Nature, the arrow on the Fel Moss. On the world map every place the step's mobs and objects spawn is a region: the Grells' woods west and north of Aldrassil and a lone Grell's place in the arrow's colour, the Nightsabers', Thistle Boars' and Gnarlpine Totems' regions fainter; on the minimap the Fel Moss region around the player, cut at the rim
